assessment: The authors shed light on the role that differentiated glioma cells exerts in promoting cancer progression, revealing that the secreted fibromodulin by differentiated glioma cells is crucial in mediating angiogenesis in glioma via integrin-dependent Notch signaling. The results are important for gaining insight into the less concerned differentiated glioma cells in promoting cancer and would potentially enrich the treatment strategy for glioma.
